label: Week 8
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-27T01:10Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Tuesday of Week 8 (day after MNF DAL 38-21 at PHI; TNF CAR@GB Thursday). Loudest by count: DAL, PHI, SEA, NYJ, CHI, IND, MIN, SF, CLE, DET. Dropped mostly college football (Florida-Georgia Atlanta naming, Iowa State Halloween unis, Indiana #DrenchGang, Deion/Colorado, ASU QB, Texas, Oregon play-caller, Bama-LSU kickoff, Big Sky/NAIA, Arizona coach tequila shots, Lady Vols), other sports (World Series Brewers-Rays, Red Sox 2004 anniversary, Knicks-Pistons, WNBA Finals, NHL jerseys/Senators, F1 Antonelli, IndyCar), memes/stunts (Native American logos meme, hashtag pun games, Madison Beer heckle, Goff Halloween costume, MCR-Cowboys cheerleader suit, Brady-Michigan satire), uniforms (Lions and Jaguars Rivalries unis), Madden cards, fan trade hypotheticals (Lamar, Jayden Daniels), creator lists/recaps (Agar, Olave tier list, huddle graphic), nostalgia (Daniels Hail Mary 2-yr, Hanford Dixon, T.O. doc), Tomlin TV takes as PIT news, stale MNF previews, items last updated before the 24h window (TB 43-13 at CAR, Rams Garrett/Ferguson windows, Browns Gabriel activation), and many cross-club duplicates. DEN, HOU, LAR, MIA, TB, TEN, WSH had no club-room story in the 24h pull.
